# Termux-Diffusion Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Non-Root On-Device Stable Diffusion Image Generation Framework for Android Termux
Compiles C++ NEON kernels directly to Android Bionic libc, running Stable Diffusion v1.5 / Turbo entirely locally within 4GB RAM.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-diffusion
- Command: pip install termux-diffusion
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic 0-Drift Output**: Bit-exact floating-point precision verified across heterogeneous ARM64 & WebGPU hardware.
- **Zero Cloud Egress Architecture**: Operates 100% on the local client without external network telemetry leaks.
- **Memory Leakage Protection**: Weakref lifetime management preventing GPU VRAM / system RAM leaks.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import termux_diffusion as td

pipe = td.DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained("sd-turbo-arm64")
image = pipe.generate("A cinematic futuristic laboratory in Seoul", steps=4)
image.save("output.png")
```
